description: Random saved Quaternius starting characters, compact world-space nearby chat bubbles, and visible Client 9 menu label.
notes: Use Node 22 and the existing incremental downloader. Download six files as raw bytes and replace each exact target path; create the listed clientVersion source file if needed.
Preserve settings, saves, artwork, all unlisted files, importer, aliases, host wrapper and dependencies. No full re-import or server changes.

Valid saved characters, including Original and Hoodie, are preserved. Missing or invalid preferences choose and save one of the ten Quaternius characters; later closet choices use the existing local save and multiplayer cosmetics field.
Chat bubbles follow rendered avatars, size to text and wrap long messages, use world depth so distant artwork cannot cover nearer bubbles, and are visible within 15 metres.
Client release number 9 is visible in the game menu. Multiplayer and basketball wire/schema versions are unchanged.

Verified: 466 tests, application typecheck, lint, upstream build and incremental host build. Phone-size browser verified character choice/reload and Client 9 label; actual WebGL verified distant-art layering, nearby wall occlusion and 15m visibility.
